policy.access: Pages were opened individually through public HTTPS, with no login, automation, CAPTCHA bypass or access-control bypass.
policy.reuse: Official source pages and relevant institutional policies were reviewed. IIT Indore's available policy material requires copyright/license compliance but does not expressly grant reuse of these public page facts. IIT Bhubaneswar's library e-resource guidance permits linking and prohibits systematic/bulk collection of licensed resources; it does not establish a grant for republishing facts from the general public admissions page. IIT (BHU)'s e-resource guidance similarly addresses licensed materials, not the public academic table. Exact links to source pages are appropriate; no source-specific permission for storing and republishing derived factual records was established. No copied prose, PDF, table, or bulk dataset is included.
policy.review: All entries are research candidates only. They are not imported, staged, verified, or public. A reviewer must check campus and scope, current applicability, and the permitted use basis before any claim is staged.
